rejected_rule.statement: The trust created by the will was valid and enforceable, with the executors having the discretion to distribute the rents and interest among the Burgher community as per the testator's wishes.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "I do not think that in the present case the objection that the trust is too vague to be capable of execution can be taken in appeal. The wide discretion conferred by clause 2 on the executors is sufficient to obviate any difficulty in regard to the selection of persons within the classes of 'the Burgher community' mentioned by the testator."
